question: In a certain code language, 'READER' is coded as 'UHGDHU'. What is the code for 'SENIOR' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘READER' is coded as 'UHGDHU’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/251ec3ec0d8acbc128fdc0d0afbae179b84394936fd9580dfaa1c29f20b88984.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe5180921c3780d798f1a72bc8796a45d73d8487d8f3704c2edbb1094694d458.png] 

Similarly, for '**SENIOR**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5075018fa246939c2e444b9d2b00d436fe56b045760b7892cc92c6dc868ce296.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2fba1761f8bad423181bf9a5495804339ef4fb2c2b7013b8161845bd340a094.png] 

So, 'SENIOR' will be coded as '**URLQHV**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
